app.title: Hypertension visit
app.disclaimer: Prototype · not clinically validated · supports, does not replace, the health worker
banner: Demo: synthetic patients only. Try a sample dictation, then turn on airplane mode.
pin.set: Choose a 4-digit PIN for this device
consent: Patient agreed to this visit being recorded
note.placeholder: Dictate or type the visit note
note.samples_none: Sample dictations will be added after the speech test.
speech.unavailable: Local speech service: off (type the note)
status.ready: All fields checked: ready to approve
flags.title: Protocol checks
flags.none: No protocol gap found: clinical judgement still applies
outbox.title: Outbox (reminders)
outbox.offline: offline: will send when the network returns
saved.title: Saved on this device
note.source_speech: From dictation: numbers must be checked
flag.urgent_bp_very_high: URGENT: BP above 200/120. Ask a clinician / refer today.
flag.urgent_bp_with_symptoms: URGENT: BP above 180/110 with a danger symptom. Ask a clinician / refer today.
flag.urgent_if_symptoms_confirmed: URGENT if confirmed: BP above 180/110 and a danger symptom is unclear. Check now.
flag.ask_danger_symptoms: Raised BP and danger signs not all recorded: ask about headache, chest pain, breathlessness, blurred vision (HEARTS).
flag.urgent_chest_pain: Chest pain: HEARTS urgent-referral sign. Ask a clinician today.
flag.urgent_breathless: Shortness of breath: HEARTS urgent-referral sign. Ask a clinician today.
flag.urgent_vision: Blurred vision: HEARTS urgent-referral sign if recent. Ask a clinician today.
flag.symptom_uncertain: A symptom is unclear: not sure, please check with the patient.
flag.refer_young_htn: Raised BP under age 40: refer to look for other causes (HEARTS).
flag.second_reading: Raised BP on one reading: take a second reading and use it (HEARTS).
flag.confirm_other_day: Raised BP is confirmed only on two different days (WHO): book a return visit.
flag.pregnancy_unknown: Woman 15-49: pregnancy status not recorded (affects medicine choice).
flag.adherence_unknown: On medicine: missed doses not asked.
flag.follow_up_too_long: BP not at target: WHO suggests monthly follow-up until it is.
speech.done: Transcribed offline in {s} s: check the text
danger_asked: I asked about danger signs: severe headache, chest pain, breathlessness, blurred vision
speech.hosted: Hosted demo: use a sample dictation (live dictation runs on the health-centre install)
missed.title: Not returned (a person decides)
missed.due: was due {date}: decide whether to call or visit
flag.danger_asked_confirmed: Danger signs asked: confirmed by health worker, {time}
